title: Health Score Green but Churn Signals Scattered Across Channels
scenario_text:
**CRM — Account: TerraLogic Inc.**
ARR: $285K | Health Score: 82 (Green) | NRR: 108% | Segment: Enterprise | CSM: Aisha Patel | Renewal: 62 days out | Last QBR: 6 weeks ago (notes: 'Great session. Champion engaged. Expansion discussion for Q3.')

**Zendesk — Organization: TerraLogic**
Open tickets: 2 (P3, P3) | CSAT last 90 days: 4.2/5 | Ticket #48291 (closed, P2, 3 weeks ago): Agent note: 'Customer contact Raj Menon mentioned they are evaluating alternatives during troubleshooting call. Did not escalate — resolved in SLA.' | Ticket #48455 (open, P3): Subject: 'SSO configuration for new IdP provider' — requester: infosec-team@terralogic.io

**Slack — #customer-success (Tuesday, 3:47 PM)**
@aisha.patel: Heads up — saw TerraLogic on the Gong call list. Anyone know why sales is talking to them?
@marcus.webb: They asked for a pricing refresh. Probably just benchmarking.
@aisha.patel: Got it, nbd
[Thread — 2 replies]
@derek.santos (Wednesday, 9:12 AM): Actually I pulled their Looker usage — DAU dropped 34% over 8 weeks. Didn't flag bc health score algo weights contract value heavier.
@aisha.patel: reacted with :eyes:
[No further replies]

**Google Doc — 'TerraLogic Account Plan H1 2026' (Last edited: 5 weeks ago)**
Section: Stakeholder Map
- Champion: VP Eng Raj Menon (strong relationship)
- EB: CTO Dana Park (met once at EBR)
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @marcus.webb, 2 weeks ago]: 'Heard from SDR that Raj accepted a role at another company. Not confirmed yet — keeping this offline until we know more.'

**Zuora — Subscription: TerraLogic Inc.**
Contract term: Annual | Auto-renew: Yes | Billing contact changed 4 weeks ago from raj.menon@terralogic.io to ap-team@terralogic.io | Last payment: On time.

**PagerDuty — Alerts (last 30 days)**
No customer-impacting incidents for TerraLogic.
question: Based on all available signals, what is the correct risk assessment and immediate action for this account?

contributor.name: Aisha Patel
contributor.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Enterprise account management, churn prevention, renewal strategy

choices: Account is at-risk due to usage decline only — reach out to Raj Menon to discuss adoption and schedule a technical win session.
Account is at-risk due to champion change — escalate to red, schedule emergency EBR with CTO Dana Park, and loop in sales leadership before renewal.
Account needs monitoring — the usage drop is concerning but auto-renew is on, so flag for next QBR discussion in the normal cadence.
Account is healthy — health score is green, CSAT is strong, no incidents. Continue standard renewal motion in 60 days.
